definitions: To become involved in an activity or situation, often one that is complicated or difficult, without intending to.
To become overly engrossed or absorbed in something, often to the point of losing track of other things or responsibilities.
To be swept along by events or emotions, often losing one's objectivity or control.
examples: She didn't mean to get caught up in the office politics.
He tends to get caught up in video games and forgets his chores.
They got caught up in the excitement of the crowd.
Don't get caught up in the drama; just focus on your work.
pastTenses: got caught up in, gotten caught up in
